coverage.test: 44.999 seconds declines local mapping; exactly 45.0 seconds permits it when other limits pass.
coverage.finding: Matches frozen plan and current `<45*64000` implementation.

coverage.test: Global segment-text mismatch, repeated segment ID rewritten to different text, and missing/non-consecutive segment ID all invalidate local mapping.
coverage.finding: Local mapping falls back; no stale timeline accepted.

coverage.test: Candidate splits across adjacent events; left/right eight-character anchors are included in a window spanning both event audio ranges, and preserved-anchor replay confirmation succeeds.
coverage.finding: Passes in pure mapping/verification test; no ASR invoked.

coverage.test: More than two separated windows and a single window exceeding 60% audio both decline localized replay.
Weak candidate whose planned audio is contained in a strong window is retained in that window.
coverage.finding: Passes. Weak candidates outside every selected strong window are not planned.

coverage.test: Registered short alias and complete edge-syllable example remain confirmable; unsupported short expansion is rejected by both original and candidate confirmation code.
coverage.finding: The candidate retains the existing conservative short-expansion gate in tested controls.

coverage.test: Fake async session returns a successful first local proposal then fails on a later window.
coverage.finding: Whole session falls back to first-pass text; prior local proposal is not published.

coverage.test: Contained change updates only owning event and rejoined text matches; cross-boundary change publishes top-level text but clears completed_segments rather than leaving stale event text.
coverage.finding: No contradictory segment text remains, but event granularity is lost for cross-boundary changes.

risks_not_fixed.risk: Weak candidates outside localized strong windows are skipped.
risks_not_fixed.code: candidate_entity_audio_repair.py:493-507; local windows are planned only from candidates scoring at least minimum_replay_score, then weak candidates are attached only when their required audio interval is fully contained in a merged strong window. If those windows resolve, _repair publishes local proposals without checking omitted weak candidates against a full replay (lines 401-426).
risks_not_fixed.impact: This bounds replay cost but is not recall-preserving for every retrieved candidate. The code should not be described as confirming all candidates under local replay.

risks_not_fixed.risk: Cross-segment corrections clear the complete segment event list.
risks_not_fixed.code: candidate_entity_audio_repair.py:159-187; a change spanning two events is not applied to either segment-local slice, so applied != len(changes) and completed_segments becomes []. The corrected top-level text is still returned at lines 188-194.
risks_not_fixed.impact: This prevents stale/conflicting event text but removes per-segment detail for that final result. Confirm downstream consumers use the authoritative top-level text when completed_segments is empty.

notes: The exact-45 behavior was checked per the frozen plan: threshold is strictly less than 45 seconds, so 45.0 seconds may attempt localization subject to timeline/window/coverage guards.
All tests use pure methods or fake async requests; no audio model, ASR service, GPU, new181 references, or production code were involved.
The candidate and original copies were read for comparison only; neither was changed.
